subject.title: Add Even Hub glasses bootstrap identity

question: Should OpenClaw core accept an Even Hub glasses client id as eligible for setup-code native bootstrap and bounded operator-token handoff?
rationale: The code slice is narrow and tested, but it changes a Gateway auth boundary and settles part of the stable client identity contract for an external glasses app, which automation cannot approve for maintainers.

options.title: Approve the narrow identity seam
options.body: After rebase, land the current Gateway/protocol slice for `openclaw-even-g2-node` with `even-hub`/`glasses` metadata and leave broader app, command-policy, Canvas, and docs work in the linked feature issue.

options.title: Generalize identity before merge
options.body: Ask the contributor to rename the wire id to a more durable Even Hub or Even Realities client id and update the external app plus proof before merging.

options.title: Keep Even Hub external for now
options.body: Pause or close the PR and require the external app to use generic node pairing until maintainers approve a first-party identity and bootstrap policy.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow identity seam
recommendation.body: After rebase, land the current Gateway/protocol slice for `openclaw-even-g2-node` with `even-hub`/`glasses` metadata and leave broader app, command-policy, Canvas, and docs work in the linked feature issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points to steipete on the adjacent bootstrap handoff, protocol documentation, and merge/review decisions around this Gateway auth boundary.
